# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary assessment artifacts generated during architecture and modernization analysis.

- [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md) — High-level application architecture and component relationship diagrams.
- [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md) — Dependency inventory grouped by functional category with risk notes.
- [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md) — API endpoints, service communication patterns, and sequence flow.
- [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md) — Persistence model, ownership boundaries, and data sensitivity notes.
- [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md) — Configuration sources, profiles, settings inventory, and secret handling summary.
- [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md) — Core domain workflows, rules, and end-to-end workflow sequence.
